dataset.name: Cora
dataset.feature_preprocessing: none (binary word indicators, as in the original notebook)

tuning.criterion: mean validation accuracy over tuning seeds (ties broken by mean validation loss)

graph_conditions.original: Cora citation graph as distributed by PyG (5,278 undirected edges).
graph_conditions.no_edges: All citation edges removed; only the self-loops the GNN layers add themselves remain. Retrained.
graph_conditions.rewired: Degree-preserving random rewiring (networkx double_edge_swap, 10 x |E| swaps, seed = run seed): every node keeps its degree, but who it is connected to is randomised.
graph_conditions.drop50: 50% of undirected edges removed uniformly at random (seed = run seed); both directions of a removed edge are dropped.
